title: zScore-N: A Neural Network for On-Chain Wallet Reputation Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.08247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wallet reputation scores decide who receives an airdrop, who can borrow, and who enters an allowlist across decentralised finance. They almost always begin as hand-written formulas: compositions of clamped logarithmic, linear and square-root transforms over behavioural features, with every threshold and point award set by hand. Such a formula is readable and deterministic, but it is piecewise and non-differentiable, it cannot improve as data accumulates, and it cannot distinguish a feature that is genuinely zero from one its pipeline failed to capture. We present zScore-N, the neural network that replaced ours in production. The formula served as its teacher: calibrated against 5,208,952 wallets sampled across 2019-2024 and verified to reproduce production output to within 2.3e-13, it supplies unlimited labelled training data at zero label noise. translated_title: zScore-N：一种用于链上钱包信誉评分的神经网络
translated_abstract: 在去中心化金融中，钱包信誉评分决定了谁能够获得空投、谁可以借款、以及谁能进入白名单。这些评分几乎总是从手写公式开始：对行为特征进行截断对数、线性与平方根变换的组合，每个阈值和加分值都由人工设定。这样的公式可读且具有确定性，但它是分段的且不可微分，无法随着数据积累而改进，也无法区分一个真正为零的特征与一个被数据管道遗漏的特征。我们提出了zScore-N，即在生产环境中取代了我们手写公式的神经网络。原公式充当了它的教师：经校准以匹配2019-2024年间采样的5,208,952个钱包，并经验证能以2.3e-13的精度复现生产输出，从而以零标签噪声提供了无限量的带标注训练数据。训练后的网络在1000分制上以0.58分RMSE（R^2 = 0.99997）复现了该公式。
tldr: 该论文提出zScore-N神经网络，以生产环境中的手写钱包信誉评分公式作为教师来生成零标签噪声的无限训练数据，训练出的网络在1000分制上以0.58分RMSE高度复现原公式，同时获得了可微分性和随数据积累持续改进的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces zScore-N, a neural network trained with zero label noise on teacher labels generated by a production hand-written wallet reputation formula, which reproduces the formula to 0.58 RMSE on a 1000-point scale while gaining differentiability and the ability to improve as data accumulates.
